# Simulated .github organization repository

This directory represents the GitHub organization's special `.github` repository for this comparison project.

It owns cross-repository material for the local organization mirror: `comparison.toml`, `.ores-compose.yaml`, TypeSpec/JSON Schema contracts, generated schemas/SQL/Protobuf/interfaces, conformance, governance, SOPS/age environment policy, database lifecycle scripts, and the organization profile under `profile/README.md`.

Sibling application/service repositories live one level up under `repos/` and must not absorb this shared authority.
